description: One station in full: "is that charger open 24 hours?", "which plugs and prices does it have?", "is it still in service?". Send id, the station number from get_nearest_stations, search_stations or find_stations_on_route. Answers with name, address, network, connector types, power in kW, port counts, access hours, price where known, the date its details were last confirmed and its page link (url), plus live port availability where a live reading exists (included for clients with a commercial API key). A removed or temporarily closed station answers with its status instead.
